title: United States, mild winters (Mid-Atlantic south, Pacific coast, Southeast inland)
description: No snow gear; warm-season lawns; heat prep before summer.

tasks.name: Flu shots
tasks.notes: Usually Sept-Oct. Pharmacies carry vaccine from late Aug.

tasks.name: Heating system check + new filter
tasks.notes: Service before the first cold nights.

tasks.name: A/C service before summer
tasks.notes: Service and replace the filter before the first hot weeks.

tasks.name: Lawn: spring pre-emergent + feed (warm-season grass)
tasks.notes: When soil reaches about 60F. Check the product label.

tasks.name: Lawn: summer feed + insect control
tasks.notes: Water in; avoid the hottest days.

tasks.name: Lawn: fall feed / overseed (cool-season grass only)
tasks.notes: Skip if your lawn is warm-season grass.

tasks.name: Check outdoor faucets and insulate for rare freezes
tasks.notes: Only for the occasional hard freeze.

tasks.name: Car heat prep: battery test, coolant, tire pressure and tread
tasks.notes: Heat is hard on batteries and tires.

tasks.name: Smoke + CO detector batteries/test
tasks.notes: Change batteries when the clocks go back.

tasks.name: Smoke + CO detector test (spring)
tasks.notes: Test when the clocks go forward.

tasks.name: Emergency kit check (flashlights, power banks, water)
